title: Stunning fossil shows dinosaurs’ distinctive path to flight
title_zh: 惊艳化石揭示恐龙独特的飞行进化路径
abstract: A fossil from a previously undiscovered species with feathery limbs, unearthed in China, adds to evidence that dinosaurs and birds evolved flight more than once.
abstract_zh: 一块来自此前未被发现物种的化石，具有羽毛状四肢，出土于中国，进一步证明恐龙与鸟类的飞行能力是多次独立进化的。
snippet: A fossil from a previously undiscovered species with feathery limbs, unearthed in China, adds to evidence that dinosaurs and birds evolved flight more than once.
